metrics.claim: timing (the flaw patched): the realized return over the hold window from when it armed
metrics.name: arm_timing_forward_return
metrics.note: the distribution of arm_date->exit_by returns; pair with false_arm + withheld_arm.

metrics.claim: preserve the edge: how much of the move already visible at the WARM the arm-timing wait gave up
metrics.name: early_vs_armed_delta
metrics.note: warm_return - arm_return, to the same exit_by; large positive => the gate clips the early edge.

metrics.claim: timing-quality discrimination: do higher-grade arms track better realized outcomes (monotonic)?
metrics.name: grade_confidence_calibration
metrics.note: calibration needs >= MIN_N per grade bucket; at seed N read the per-bucket n, not the medians.

metrics.claim: name-selection (the flaw patched): did the ranked headline outperform the rest of the basket?
metrics.name: name_selection_lift
metrics.note: relative (isolates selection from theme beta); on the seed this is ~1 theme decision — a case, not a rate.

metrics.claim: timing precision: arms whose realized hold-window return was adverse (the gate firing wrongly)
metrics.name: false_arm_rate
metrics.note: report the raw count at small N; a percentage would imply precision the data can't support.

metrics.claim: timing's false-negative side: the move during windows the gate WITHHELD (a gate that never fires is useless)
metrics.name: withheld_arm_counterfactual
metrics.note: single-name theses only; positive => the withhold cost upside, negative => it dodged a drawdown.

metrics.claim: timing (the exit side): does the edge persist to exit_by, or decay earlier? (the liveness dials)
metrics.name: exit_by_vs_rollover
metrics.note: days from the realized peak to exit_by, and the return given up by holding to exit_by past it.
